types.plan.name: Section name in the sidebar and the card-type label for the 'Plans' card type (the plan's root card).
types.diagram.name: Sidebar section holding architecture diagram cards. 'single' is one diagram card.
types.agent.name: Sidebar section holding rules written for AI coding agents.
types.db.name: Sidebar section holding database table cards. 'single' is one table.
types.state.name: Sidebar section holding state-machine cards.
types.external.name: Sidebar section holding cards for third-party services the project calls.
types.style.name: Sidebar section holding design-token cards (colours, type, spacing).
types.file.name: Sidebar section holding cards that each describe one file in the code repository.
types.plan.single: One card of this type as a noun used INSIDE a sentence ('+ new {type}', 'New {type} card'). Lowercase in English except acronyms. Every types.*.single key works the same way: use your language's normal noun form and capitalisation.
types.group.system: Small uppercase sidebar group heading: the back-end types (API, DB, events, jobs…).
types.group.interface: Small uppercase sidebar group heading: pages, components, style.
types.group.code: Small uppercase sidebar group heading: repo files and tests.
status.planned: A card's status. Shown in a small pill that is often uppercased by CSS; keep it one short word, lowercase where the language allows.
status.building: A card's status: work in progress. Short, one word.
status.built: A card's status: implemented. Short, one word.
status.verified: A card's status: implemented and checked against the code. Short, one word.
status.none: Option in the status menu that clears a card's status.
